sloka: विगर्हमाण: कैकेयीं सहितो मन्थरामपि ।अभिगम्य जनो रामं बाष्पपूर्णमुखो ऽभवत् ॥ २.१०२.४६॥
transliteration: vigarhamāṇa: kaikeyīṁ sahito mantharāmapi ।abhigamya jano rāmaṁ bāṣpapūrṇamukho 'bhavat ॥ 2.102.46॥

translations.english: All those men with faces full of tears, reproaching Kaikeyi and Manthara (all the way), approached Rama.
